 Multiple agencies responded to a reported vehicle crash at Lookout Point on Sunday, Nov. 1, 2026. (Klark Byrd, Oil City News) 
 EDITOR’S NOTE: An update on this story is available here . 
 CASPER, Wyo. — Multiple emergency crews responded Sunday morning to Casper Mountain, where a vehicle reportedly struck a guardrail and went over the edge near Lookout Point.
 Traffic along Wyoming Highway 251, also known as Casper Mountain Road, was reduced to one lane near the crash site. 
 Emergency dispatch records from 9:10 a.m. said first responders saw skid marks along the road and were working down the hillside to determine if anyone remained inside the vehicle.
 Oil City News is withholding details regarding the vehicle’s make, model and color until law enforcement confirms next of kin have been contacted.
 Responding agencies included the Natrona County Fire Protection District, Casper Fire-EMS, Casper Police Department, Natrona County Sheriff’s Office and Wyoming Highway Patrol.
 Oil City News has reached out to the Natrona County Sheriff’s Office for confirmation and additional information. This story will be updated as details become available.
